# BYZ scope. Calm enough for this line's events (design 4.1): no civil war, no theme revolt, not the house of Osman's chain,
# the City not lost. World steps do not read it.
oe_alb_calm = {
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active }
    oe_l7_fallen = no
}
# Country scope. A country a world step may act on: AI, outside the empire's bloc, neither the Ottomans nor Venice.
oe_alb_free = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } NOT = { tag = TUR } NOT = { tag = VEN } }
# Country scope. Such a country holds land in the Albanian area (W1 counts them: at least two).
oe_alb_area_owner = { oe_alb_free = yes any_owned_location = { area = area:albania_area } }
# Country scope. An Albanian lord (W1, .1): holds land in the area and is seated there or Albanian; Zeta, AI and outside the
# bloc, counts too.
oe_alb_lord = {
    OR = {
        AND = { oe_alb_area_owner = yes OR = { capital ?= { area = area:albania_area } culture = culture:albanian } }
        AND = { tag = ZTA is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
    }
}
# Location scope. Its owner may hand it over in peace: a free owner (above) that controls it, no siege, and not its capital
# unless it is the owner's last place (Latin Greece's ep13 rule).
oe_alb_loc_free = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_alb_free = yes } controller ?= owner has_siege = no OR = { is_capital = no owner = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { count >= 2 } } } } }
# Location scope. A player or the empire's bloc owns it (a world step that would take it is skipped for this place).
oe_alb_loc_out = { has_owner = yes owner = { OR = { is_ai = no oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
# Any scope. The Ottomans exist, are AI, outside the bloc, and the house of Osman's chain is not running.
oe_alb_tur_ok = {
    country_exists = c:TUR
    NOT = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } }
    c:TUR = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
}
oe_alb_tur_out = {
    OR = {
        c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active }
        AND = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { OR = { is_ai = no oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    }
}
# Any scope. Venice exists, is AI and outside the bloc / is a player's or on the empire's side.
oe_alb_ven_ok = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
oe_alb_ven_out = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { OR = { is_ai = no oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
# Any scope. The bloc holds land in the Albanian area or in northern Greece (.2, design 4.4: the simpler of the two forms).
oe_alb_bloc_near = {
    OR = {
        area:albania_area = { any_location_in_area = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        area:northern_greece_area = { any_location_in_area = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Can pay $months$ months of income (oe_fin_month, the finance line's unit).
oe_alb_can_pay = { gold >= { value = oe_fin_month multiply = $months$ } }

# ---- world steps (design 4.2). oe_alb_w<n>_ok: the step can run now (the test buttons check it too; the window, the chance
# and the waits aside). Every country concerned is AI and outside the empire's bloc.
# W1 Savra: the Ottomans fit and hold land in the Balkans; at least two free owners in the Albanian area.

# W2 Venetian Durazzo: Venice fits; Durazzo's owner is free, holds it in hand and is at peace with Venice.

    oe_alb_ven_ok = yes
    location:durres = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes owner = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:VEN } } }

# W3 Lezhë and Scutari: Venice fits; one of the two qualifies (Scutari only from Zeta or a lord seated in Zeta).
oe_alb_w3_lezha = { location:lezha = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes owner = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:VEN } } } }

    location:shkoder = {
        oe_alb_loc_free = yes
        owner = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:VEN } OR = { tag = ZTA capital ?= { province_definition = province_definition:zeta_province } } }
    }

oe_alb_w3_ok = { oe_alb_ven_ok = yes OR = { oe_alb_w3_lezha = yes oe_alb_w3_shkoder = yes } }
oe_alb_w3_skip = { OR = { oe_alb_ven_out = yes AND = { location:lezha = { oe_alb_loc_out = yes } location:shkoder = { oe_alb_loc_out = yes } } } }
